description: Curated Yomira-compatible Source Packs maintained outside the app.

sourcePacks.description: Expanded Yomira-compatible source definitions generated from supported Keiyoushi families.
releaseNotes: Delivers the current reader definitions through the existing Curated and Expanded pack identities; no separate Reader Beta import is required.
Adds LikeManga, ManhwaToon, Chikari, ToonVerse, XComic (.me/.net), Swarm and Kagane, plus the previously verified reader profiles. Includes current KuraManga and ManhwaDen profiles.
Retains every prior Source ID. Library links and existing My Sources selections are preserved; new definitions are available inside the pack without automatically adding them to My Sources.
Requires Yomira iOS 0.2.27 (20) or newer for the newer built-in connector profiles.

Canary publication: the 23 Reader Beta profiles retain their dated bounded live evidence. The legacy catalog is not certified as fully working; Browser Verification or unavailable upstreams may affect individual sources.
